description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: CHAT / HARNESS mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness
ANT (AI-native Teams) connects a DeepSeek Harness Desktop profile to team identity and approved models.
AI 写作工作台（含工具桥）：远程Claude与Codex，本机目录工具由DSH执行与审批。

DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — p…

AI Book Shelf: read EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, FB2 and DOCX; select text for one-click background and explanations, then follow up without leaving the page; full-book search, online book search and custom sources; paper mode with translation, bilingual compare, explanations and follow-ups; dos…
Desktop blue fish pet for DeepSeek Harness: per-pixel transparent WinForms window, text chat, and cloud speech-to-text voice conversation.

Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.

Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
Local code-agent harness registry and glue: scoped homes, /<harness> login and sessions commands, delegation provider contracts, and the roster-driven browser settings section

Kimi Code harness for dsh-local-agent: scoped KIMI_CODE_HOME, one-shot kimi -p delegation visible in the 子代理 surface, session records and preset wiring; the session-granted `subagent_kimi` delegation tool ships as the package's `./tool` composition entry
柚客 Pomelo：内容获客工作台（DSH 插件）
Free web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with multi-engine fallback (Tavily, Exa, Brave, Baidu, SearXNG and more)
QQ bridge mode console for DeepSeek Harness settings UI (chat / closed-agent / reserved / reserved2)
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
DSH 的「可编辑人设」agent preset 插件：把群聊人设（啾啾·群聊）从 YAML 里搬到一个文本文件，在「设置 → 群聊人设」页面直接编辑，保存即生效、无需重启。register 出来的 preset 可与 dsh-qqbot-lite 搭配使用。

Google-AI-Studio-style turn controls for DeepSeek Harness, in one install: edit a prompt and re-run it, re-run a reply in place, delete a turn from the model context, render sent prompts as Markdown, and trim idle session logs on boot. Self-contained: the plugin list shows this one row, and the fiv…
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
DSH plugin that turns this host into a bridge-mcp provider: exec + file primitives over WebSocket, with a settings page.
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。

dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed loop on RDB persistence, with the conversatio…
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
Cordis plugin: image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
Native DSH browser tools on agent-browser: snapshot+ref automation, batched actions, live viewport panel. One-line install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-browser
Deep PTC mode for DeepSeek Harness with a bilingual UI, interruptible background jobs, selectable shells, and third-party PTC compatibility.
配速计算：根据距离与时间换算出配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时），支持任意距离与时分秒输入。Running pace calculator: converts distance and time into min/km pace and km/h speed.
A practical guide to DSH plugin quality: ENTRY checks, FLOW checks, and BOOST guidance. Community guide; not official, not a certification, not a ranking.

AryaCode engineering bundle: one install surface for the Studio 5000 L5X, FactoryTalk View ME, MotionWorks IEC and FactoryTalk Optix surfaces, one row per product, with the ladder and display previews.
DSH 原生分层上下文压缩：模型自己把旧对话折成三层摘要，只写宿主本来就认识的会话事件。名字取自「渐渐消退」——模拟记忆的自然衰退，越旧的内容分辨率越低，但不是删掉。

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: let the model schedule its own alarms (once / interval / cron with random jitter), wake cold sessions on time, gate model-initiated follow-ups with quiet hours and a daily budget, and reclaim silent wake turns with tombstone compaction; ships a we…
Profile-wide odai governance and routing bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
Right-click menu for file links in the DeepSeek Harness chat: open with, save as, copy path, copy content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
DSH Desktop 界面增强：页内查找（Cmd+F）、轮次编号、上下文压缩行常显、建议、每步耗时、折叠文件夹状态计数、会话信息（含上下文注入 C1 视图）、工具管理、Skill 管理、独立远程接入与手机体验，以及智能建议、会话能力和远程接入的持久诊断日志。
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
DSH bundle: syncs the sicau-pmt (oh-pmt-api) model catalog into a @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai route, with thinking-effort levels
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
鲸编程 - 不只是手机遥控操作电脑,而是将电脑级的Agent能力装进手机

Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.

qq-bridge 的 DSH agent preset bundle：把 qq-chat / qq-chat-v2 / qq-agent-readonly / qq-agent-workspace / qq-agent-full（v0.3.0 L1~L3 运维 Agent）作为 @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset 行插入（DSH 0.1.7+ 的 preset 机制），并携带两个 preset 共用的 qq-tool-restrict 安全守卫

QQ 桥接（qq-bridge-me）工作区的专用 DSH agent preset bundle：qq-bridge-dev。知道桥接四层架构、运行版与源码版分工、五条硬约束与真实踩坑表，带 DSH 创造模式工具（dsh-tool-cordis）与 skill-filesystem，用于给 qq-bridge-me 加插件 / MCP 工具 / #skill 指令 / 改控制台。不含任何本机绝对路径：工作目录、桥接目录、node 路径都以你实际环境为准。

Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)
dsh-Fang (瓮城) — mother/fork plugin development environment for DeepSeek Harness: one readonly mother, a disposable child dsh-Web per task.

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
DSH plugin manager: official/community grouped plugin list with localized descriptions, one-click enable/disable and uninstall, plus a GitHub dsh-plugin market tab.
BioCore DSH UI: per-session state tab, standalone instrument panel, /api/biocore/state, session/event one_turn updates, /bio sync.
